title: Eva
imageAlt: Headline "An AI assistant that lives on your computer" next to Eva's face, a black visor with two happy blue eyes in a white ring, above a screenshot of her chat page in dark mode
description: *Eva* is a **personal AI assistant** that runs on my own computer. She works over my **vault**, a **git repository** of plain-text notes, and I talk to her through a **web app** and a **Telegram bot**.

I design and build her as the next version of my earlier assistant, *Wall-I*. She is a **super harness**: she runs coding agents such as **Claude Code**, hands them project work, and sends **scheduled messages**.
Eva is **open source**, and she installs with one command on Windows or Linux.
